issues.title: [Bug]: Improve Zed ACP compatibility and long-running Goal state, planning, and phase consistency
[Bug]: Auto-continue triggers while waiting for background Shell test results (OpenCode V2)
Nothing registers on opencode 1.18.25: /goal commands and goal tools silently absent
Real-world feedback from 20+ V2 goal runs: waiting for user input, Esc -> resume, and >50-token refusal loops
Auto-continue delivers the continuation prompt while the session is still streaming, and its scheduled wake-up is dropped on busy early-returns
